blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As a prototypical latent world model, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide strong semantic representations. However, dense patch representations expose a redundant interface to downstream predictors, which must implicitly infer spatial organization and temporal correspondence, presenting three challenges. First, object information is distributed across patches, forcing each downstream predictor to redundantly recover object structure that could otherwise be reused across tasks before modeling interactions. Second, the lack of explicit entity correspondence across time makes historical transitions expensive, restricting the predictor's flexibility in utilizing context. Third, without explicit transport structure, existing JEPA models typically use pointwise l1/l2 distances, which are insensitive to spatial displacement when predicted and goal supports are largely disjoint. We propose the Slot-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Slot-JEPA), which decomposes dense representations into stable semantic slots and time-varying spatial masks. Pretrained once and frozen downstream, this decomposition exposes a reusable object-structured interface. Building on it, our Transition Memory Predictor (TMP) stores visual transitions as compact masks and retrieves useful context using statistics of corresponding slots. Its two branches separate slot-specific dynamics from shared cross-slot dynamics. We further use Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to supervise mask prediction and evaluate candidate plans by transporting mass between aligned predicted and goal masks, providing a signal better aligned with spatial progress. Across seven visual-understanding benchmarks, the slot-reconstructed features remain transferable. Slot-JEPA also improves goal-conditioned planning across six planar environments and four robotic arm planning tasks on the REALM-JEPA benchmark.
blocks.zh: 作为典型的潜伏世界模型,联合预测建筑提供了强烈的语义表述。 然而,密集的补丁表示向下游预测器暴露了一个冗余的接口,它必须隐含地推断空间组织和时间对应,这带来了三个挑战. 首先,对象信息在补丁之间分布,迫使每个下游预测器在模拟相互作用之前重复恢复本来可以跨任务重复使用的对象结构. 第二,由于长期缺乏明确的实体对应关系,历史过渡费用昂贵,限制了预测者利用背景的灵活性。 第三,没有明确的运输结构,现有的JEPA模型通常使用点/l2距离,在预测和目标支持基本脱节时,这些距离对空间位移不敏感。 我们提议采用以槽为基础的联合预测结构(Slot-JEPA),它将密集的表示分解为稳定的语义插槽和时空变化的空间面具。 这种分解会暴露出可重复使用的对象结构接口。 在此基础上,我们的过渡内存预置器(TMP)将视觉过渡作为紧凑的口罩存储,并利用相应插槽的统计检索有用的上下文. 其两个分支将特定档位动态与共享跨档位动态分开. 我们还利用不平衡的优化运输(UOT),通过在对齐的预测口罩和瞄准口罩之间运输质量来监督口罩预测和评估候选计划,提供与空间进步更吻合的信号. 在7项可视理解的基准中,时间档调整的特征仍然可以转让。 Slot-JEPA还改进了6个平面环境的有目标条件的规划,以及REALM-JEPA基准上的4个机器人臂部规划任务.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Building agents that can anticipate the consequences of their actions is a long-standing goal of artificial intelligence. World models pursue this goal by predicting how an environment evolves, allowing agents to evaluate possible behaviors before acting ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) . Early visual world models operate in pixel space ( Finn et al., 2016 ; Finn and Levine, 2017 ) , but reconstructing every pixel requires modeling details that may be unpredictable. Latent world models instead predict action-conditioned changes in learned representations ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ) without rendering pixels.
blocks.zh: 建立能够预见其行动后果的特工是人工智能的长期目标. 世界模型通过预测环境如何演变来追求这一目标,允许代理商在行动前评价可能的行为(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018.). 早期的视觉世界模型在像素空间中运行(Finn等,2016;Finn和Levine,2017),但重建每个像素需要模型细节,可能无法预测. 相反地,Latent世界模型预测了在不渲染像素的情况下,在学习到的表达方式(Hafner等人,2019年;Hafner等人,2020年)中的行动条件变化。

blocks.en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide a promising foundation for this approach. Typically, JEPAs learn to predict masked image/video representations from visible context ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) . DINO-WM predicts representations changing from offline interactions ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , while V-JEPA 2-AC post-trains an action-conditioned predictor for planning ( Assran et al., 2025 ) . Recent work further improves representation density and temporal consistency ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , or adapts the model online ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Parallel studies diagnose structural degradation and over-dispersed patch semantics in dense self-supervised representations, and develop structure-aware selection or semantic concentration to improve dense transfer ( Dai et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2026 ) . For video representations, T-CoRe reduces temporal sampling uncertainty using two-sided temporal correspondence, while Co-Settle studies the trade-off between intra-video consistency and inter-video separability during image-to-video transfer ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 联合预测结构为这一做法提供了有希望的基础。 通常,联合环保局会学习从可见的上下文中预测被掩盖的图像/视频表现(Asran等人,2023年;Bardes等人,2024年)。 DINO-WM预测来自离线相互作用的表示变化(周等,2025年),而V-JEPA 2-AC 后切入是规划的有行动条件的预测器(Assran等,2025年). 近期的工作进一步提高了代表密度和时间一致性(Mur-Labadia等,2026年),或在网上调整模型(Wang等,2026年)。 平行研究诊断出在密集自监督的表达中的结构退化和过度分散的补丁语义,并发展出结构感知选择或语义集中,以改善密集转移(Dai等,2025;Wen等,2026). 对于视频表达,T-CoRe通过双侧时间对应来减少时间采样不确定性,而Co-Settle则研究了图像到视频传输过程中视频内一致性和视频间分离性之间的取舍(刘等,2025;刘等,2026).

blocks.en: Despite this progress, we argue that dense patch representations might not be ideal for downstream dynamics learning and planning for three reasons: 1) An object’s information is distributed across patches, leaving its structure implicit. Each task-specific predictor must recover this structure, model interactions, and decode the result back into patches. The object organization encoded during pretraining is not exposed as a reusable interface. 2) A predictor needs relevant and diverse context to balance local and global views of dynamics. Yet patch-based history is highly redundant, making transitions expensive to store and their relevance costly to compute. 3) Patch representations form dense spatial grids without explicit entity correspondence or transport structure. Existing methods therefore compare predicted and goal grids with pointwise ℓ 1 \ell_{1} or ℓ 2 \ell_{2} distance ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . When their supports are largely disjoint, these losses can become insensitive to spatial displacement and rank progress poorly.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但我们认为,对于下游动态学习和规划来说,密集的补丁表述可能并不理想,原因有三: (1) 物体的信息在补丁之间分布,使其结构隐含。 每个任务特定的预测器必须恢复这个结构,模型相互作用,并将结果解码为补丁. 在预训期间被编码的对象组织不作为可重复使用的界面被曝光. (2) 预测者需要相关和多样的背景,以平衡当地和全球对动态的看法。 然而以补丁为基础的历史非常冗余,使过渡变得昂贵而存储,其相关性也变得昂贵而计算. 3)补丁表示形成密集的空间网格,没有明确的实体通信或运输结构. 因此,现有方法将预测和入球网格与指针1\ell\1}或指针2\ell\2}距离(周等,2025;Assran等,2025)进行比较。 当它们的支持基本脱节时,这些损失可能变得对空间迁移不敏感并给进展排出低等的位置。

blocks.en: We therefore propose Slot -based J oint- E mbedding P redictive A rchitecture ( Slot-JEPA ) , which turns dense patches into a reusable object-structured interface. A task-agnostic decomposition module addresses problem 1) by factorizing the dense feature field into stable semantic slots ( Locatello et al., 2020 ; Seitzer et al., 2023 ; Nam et al., 2026 ) and time-varying spatial masks. Pretrained once and frozen for downstream tasks, it preserves the original feature field through reconstruction while exposing its object organization.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议使用基于J oint-E mbedding P 重排 A rchitecture(Slot-JEPA),将稠密的补丁变成可重复使用的对象结构接口. 一个任务不可知分解模块解决了问题1,将密集的地物场分解成稳定的语义槽(Locallo等人,2020年;Seitzer等人,2023年;Nam等人,2026年)和时间变化的空间口罩。 它通过重建保留了原来的地物场,同时暴露了它的物体组织。

blocks.en: For problem 2) , the temporal stability of slots allows visual history to be stored and reused as compact masks rather than high-dimensional patch representations. Inspired by memory-based Video Object Segmentation ( Oh et al., 2019 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ) , our proposed T ransition M emory P redictor ( TMP ) uses statistics of masks associated with the same slots to assess relevance to the current query and retrieve relevant and diverse, potentially non-contiguous transitions. We further design two branches that separate slot-specific dynamics from inter-slot interaction dynamics, reducing the burden on dynamics learning.
blocks.zh: 对于问题2,槽的时间稳定性使得视觉历史可以被存储并被再用为紧凑口罩,而不是高维补丁表现. 在基于记忆的视频对象分解(Oh等,2019;Cheng等,2024)的启发下,我们提出的Transition M emory P再接力(TMP)使用与同槽相联的口罩统计来评估与当前查询的相关性并检索相关而多样,潜在的非相接过渡. 我们进一步设计了两个分支,将分档特定动态与分档间互动动态分开,减轻了动态学习的负担.

blocks.en: Finally, problem 3) motivates our Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) loss for planning. Using the temporal correspondence of slots, it replaces pointwise comparison between predicted and goal patch representations with transport between their aligned masks. Moving mask mass across space provides a smooth planning signal that remains informative over long displacements.
blocks.zh: 最后,问题3促使我们规划失去平衡的优化运输。 利用时段的时空对应,将预测与目标补丁的表示的指针比较取而代之,代之以相接口罩之间的运输. 跨越空间移动口罩质量提供了一个平稳的规划信号,在长时间的迁移中仍能提供信息。

blocks.en:
Slot decomposition turns a perception-oriented patch field into a reusable interface for prediction, memory maintenance, and goal evaluation. Across seven visual-understanding benchmarks, slot-reconstructed features retain most of the semantic information. Across six planar tasks and four Robotic Arm Planning tasks from the REALM-JEPA dataset, Slot-JEPA improves goal-conditioned planning.
The contributions are: • We introduce Slot-JEPA, which compresses patch representations into shared semantic slots and time-varying masks, separating reusable visual organization from task-specific dynamics and easing predictor learning. • We develop TMP to retrieve relevant, non-contiguous transitions from memory instead of relying only on a continuous recent-history window. • We predict action effects in mask space and use UOT for goal evaluation, providing a signal better aligned with spatial progress when ℓ 1 / ℓ 2 \ell_{1}/\ell_{2} losses become insensitive to displacement.
blocks.zh:
Slot分解将一个面向感知的补丁字段变成一个可重复使用的界面,用于预测,内存维护和目标评价. 在7个可视理解的基准中,分档重构的功能保留了大部分语义信息. 在REALM-JEPA数据集的6个计划任务和4个机器人武装规划任务中,Slot-JEPA改进了有目标条件的规划.
贡献是:我们引入了Slot-JEPA,它将补丁表达压缩为共享语义插槽和时间变化口罩,将可重复使用的视觉组织与任务特定的动态区分开来并放松预测器学习. 我们开发了TPP,从内存中取回相关的、非相接的过渡,而不是仅仅依赖一个连续的最近历史的窗口。 我们预测掩蔽空间中的动作效果,并利用UOT进行目标评价,当l 1/l 2\ell 1}/\ell\2}损失对迁移变得不敏感时,提供与空间进展更相适应的信号。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Slot-JEPA connects four lines of work that are often studied separately: joint-embedding representation prediction, object-centric decomposition and dynamics, memory-based video segmentation, and optimal transport. Together, they motivate its slot-and-mask state, transition memory, and spatial planning objective.
blocks.zh: Slot-JEPA连接了经常被单独研究的四行工作:联合嵌入表达预测,以对象为中心的分解和动态,基于记忆的视频分解,以及最优的传输. 它们共同激励着它的槽和罩子状态、过渡记忆和空间规划目标。

blocks.en: 2.1 Joint-Embedding Predictive World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 联合预测世界模式

blocks.en: Joint-embedding methods predict target representations rather than reconstructing raw observations, allowing the learned state to retain predictable semantic structure while discarding some pixel-level detail. I-JEPA introduces this principle for masked image regions, and V-JEPA extends it to spatiotemporal video representations ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) . Dense self-supervised features from DINO and DINOv2 provide another strong latent target for spatial prediction ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ) . Recent work identifies structural degradation over the course of self-supervised training and over-dispersion of semantically related patches, then addresses these issues through structure-aware model selection or explicit semantic concentration ( Dai et al., 2025 ; Wen et al., 2026 ) . In video self-supervision, T-CoRe uses frames on both sides of the prediction target to reduce temporal sampling uncertainty, while Co-Settle studies image-to-video transfer as a balance between within-video temporal consistency and cross-video semantic separability ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . These methods primarily concern how a useful visual representation is learned.
blocks.zh: 联合嵌入方法预测目标表示而不是重建原始观测,使所学状态能够保留可以预测的语义结构,同时丢弃一些像素级的细节. I-JEPA对被遮掩的形象区域引入了这一原则,而V-JEPA则将其延伸至瞬间视频展示(Asran等,2023;Bardes等,2024.). 来自DINO和DINOv2的自导自演特性为空间预测提供了又一强烈的潜在目标(Caron等,2021;Oquab等,2024)。 最近的工作通过自我监督的培训和过度分散与血缘有关的补丁,确定结构退化,然后通过结构意识模型选择或明确的语义集中来解决这些问题(Dai等,2025;Wen等,2026)。 在视频自监控中,T-CoRe使用预测目标两侧的帧来减少时间采样不确定性,而Co-Settle研究图像到视频传输作为视频内时间一致性和跨视频语义分解的平衡(刘等,2025;刘等,2026). 这些方法主要涉及如何学习有用的视觉表现。

blocks.en: A second line of work turns representation prediction into an action-conditioned world model. DINO-WM predicts future DINOv2 patch features from offline interaction trajectories and plans by comparing imagined features with goal features ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . V-JEPA 2-AC post-trains a frame-causal, action-conditioned predictor for robot planning, and V-JEPA 2.1 improves the spatial density and temporal consistency of the underlying video features ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . Subsequent studies isolate the effects of representation, predictive objective, and planner design ( Terver et al., 2026 ) ; AdaJEPA adapts the encoder and predictor online from newly observed transitions ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ; and LeWorldModel investigates stable end-to-end training of JEPA world models from pixels ( Maes et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 第二行工作将表现预测转化为一个有行动条件的世界模型。 DINO-WM通过将所想象的地物与目标地物相提并论(周等,2025年),从离线互动地道和计划中预测出未来的DINov2补丁地物. V-JEPA 2-AC 后切入机器人规划的帧-因果,有动作条件的预测器,而V-JEPA 2.1 改善了基本视频功能的空间密度和时间一致性(Asran等,2025;Mur-Labadia等,2026)。 随后的研究将代表,预测目标,以及规划者设计的效果隔离出来(Terver等,2026年;AdaJEPA在线将编码器和预测器从新观测到的过渡(Wang等,2026年;LeWorldModel调查JEPA世界模型的稳定端到端训练从像素(Maes等,2026年)).

blocks.en: Slot-JEPA is complementary to these advances: rather than replacing joint-embedding pretraining, it introduces a structured slot-and-mask interface between a pretrained dense encoder and action dynamics, together with a spatial objective for prediction and planning.
blocks.zh: Slot-JEPA是这些进步的补充:它不是取代联合嵌入预训,而是引入了预先训练的密集编码器与动作动力学之间结构化的插槽和掩模接口,以及用于预测和规划的空间目标.

blocks.en: 2.2 Object-Centric Representation and Dynamics
blocks.zh: 2.2 物体子特征和动态

blocks.en: Slot Attention maps a set of visual features to a small collection of exchangeable components through competition for input tokens ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) . Subsequent methods extend this idea from individual images to video. SIMONe separates temporally abstracted object latents from per-pixel mixture assignments ( Kabra et al., 2021 ) ; SAVi and SAVi++ use temporally propagated slots to support object tracking in synthetic and real videos ( Kipf et al., 2022 ; Elsayed et al., 2022 ) ; and SlotFormer learns dynamics over slot sequences for video prediction and planning ( Wu et al., 2023 ) . DINOSAUR shows that reconstructing pretrained self-supervised features, rather than RGB pixels, can induce object-centric components in real images ( Seitzer et al., 2023 ) . This last observation is especially relevant to our goal of reorganizing a pretrained feature field without discarding its semantic information.
blocks.zh: 通过对输入符的竞争,将一组可视特征映射到一小堆可交换组件上(Locallo等,2020年)。 随后的方法将这一想法从个人图像扩展到视频. SIMONe将时间上抽象的物体潜伏物与每像素混合物分配物区分开来(Kabra等,2021年;SAVi和SAVi++使用时间上传播的槽来支持合成和真实视频中的物体跟踪(Kipf等,2022年; Elsayed等,2022;和SlotFormer在槽序上学习动态,用于视频预测和规划(Wu等,2023.). DINOSAUR显示,重建预先训练的自控特性,而不是RGB像素,可以在真实图像中诱发以对象为中心的组件(Seitzer等,2023年). 最后一点与我们的目标特别相关,即重组一个经过预先训练的特征域而不丢弃其语义信息。

blocks.en: Object-centric prediction commonly updates the full latent content of every slot at each time step. Causal-JEPA, the closest joint-embedding counterpart, applies masked and future prediction to object-centric latents ( Nam et al., 2026 ) ; Better Slots, Better Worlds studies how the quality of these latents affects prediction, planning, and robustness ( Nazirjonov et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, Slot-JEPA holds a reference-derived semantic slot bank fixed within a prediction context and predicts its spatial masks. As in unsupervised slot learning generally, these slots are object-centric components rather than guaranteed physical-instance segmentations.
blocks.zh: 以对象为中心的预测通常更新每个时段每个时段的全部潜在内容. Causal-JEPA是最近的联合组合对应方,对以物体为中心的潜在物适用了蒙蔽的和未来预测(Nam等,2026年;Better Slots,Better Worlds研究这些潜在物的质量如何影响预测、规划和稳健性(Nazirjonov等,2026年)。 相形之下,Slot-JEPA持有一个在预测上下文中固定的参考衍生语义槽库并预测其空间口罩. 与一般无监督的插槽学习一样,这些插槽是以对象为中心的组件,而不是保证物理内分.

blocks.en: 2.3 Memory-Based VOS and Transition Memory
blocks.zh: 2.3 基于内存的VOS和过渡内存

blocks.en: Semi-supervised Video Object Segmentation (VOS) must preserve the identity of a target while its appearance and location change. Early propagation methods predict the next mask from an initial annotation and recent frames or masks ( Perazzi et al., 2017 ; Oh et al., 2018 ) . Space-Time Memory Networks instead store past image–mask pairs and let the current query read from them ( Oh et al., 2019 ) . XMem separates working, long-term, and sensory memories for long videos, while adaptive memory methods retain frames according to their utility rather than keeping every observation ( Cheng and Schwing, 2022 ; Pourganjalikhan and Poullis, 2022 ) . Cutie introduces object-level memory reading, and SAM 2 develops a streaming memory architecture for promptable segmentation ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Ravi et al., 2025 ) . Collectively, these methods show that a query can benefit from selected non-contiguous history instead of only the immediately preceding frame.
blocks.zh: 半监督 视频对象分解(VOS)在外观和位置变化时必须保留目标的身份. 早期的传播方法从最初的注释和最近的帧或口罩中预测出下一个口罩(Perazzi等,2017;Oh等,2018.). 空间-时空记忆网络转而存储过去的图像-mask对并让当前查询从它们读取(Oh等,2019). XMem将长相视频的工作、长期和感官记忆分开,而适应性记忆方法则根据其效用保留帧,而不是保留每一次观察(Cheng and Schwing, 2022; Pourganjalikhan and Poullis, 2022). Cutie引入了对象级内存读取,而SAM 2则开发出一流的内存架构,用于快速分解(Cheng等,2024;Ravi等,2025.). 这些方法合在一起表明,查询可以从选定的非相干历史中受益,而不是仅仅从眼前的框架中受益。

blocks.en: TMP transfers this memory principle from perceptual propagation to controlled prediction. Unlike VOS memories that store evidence for locating a target, TMP stores observed source–action–target transitions and retrieves potentially non-contiguous examples to predict a new action outcome.
blocks.zh: TMP将这种内存原理从知觉传播转移到可控预测. 与存储确定目标的证据的 VOS 记忆不同, TMP 存储了观察到的 source - action - target 转换, 并检索潜在的非相干的例子来预测新的行动结果 。

blocks.en: 2.4 Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Visual Correspondence and Control
blocks.zh: 2.4 视觉通信和控制的不平衡最佳运输

blocks.en: Pointwise distances compare features or masks only at matching grid locations. They can therefore provide little information about how far mass should move when predicted and target supports do not overlap. Optimal transport instead compares nonnegative spatial measures under a ground cost, explicitly charging for displacement between source and target locations. Entropic regularization makes the problem amenable to efficient Sinkhorn scaling ( Cuturi, 2013 ) . Unbalanced optimal transport (UOT) further relaxes exact marginal matching by assigning a finite penalty to the creation or removal of mass ( Chizat et al., 2018b ; Chizat et al., 2018a ) . This relaxation is appropriate for visual masks, whose total mass can change with occlusion, viewpoint, scale, or imperfect decomposition.
blocks.zh: 尖端距离只比较匹配网格位置的特性或口罩. 因此,当预测和目标支持不相重叠时,它们能够提供的关于质量应移动多远的信息很少。 相反,在地面成本下,最佳运输方式比较了非负空间措施,明确收取源地与目标地之间的迁移费。 (Cuturi,2013年)。 不平衡的最佳运输(UOT)进一步放松了精确的边际匹配,对质量的产生或去除设定了有限度的处罚(Chizat等,2018b;Chizat等,2018a.). 这种放松适用于视觉口罩,其总质量可随被遮住,视线,尺度或不完美的分解而变化.

blocks.en: Slot-JEPA applies UOT between masks with the same slot index, using their shared correspondence to preserve semantic grouping. UOT complements pointwise and reconstruction losses during training and supplies a displacement-aware goal cost during planning; its ground cost can additionally incorporate obstacle geometry in planar environments.
blocks.zh: Slot-JEPA在口罩之间应用UOT同位指数,利用其共享的通信来保留语义分组. UOT补充了培训过程中的指向和重建损失,并提供了规划过程中的流离失所意识目标成本;其地面成本还可以将障碍几何学纳入平面环境。

blocks.en: An overview of Slot-JEPA is shown in Fig. 1 . Slot-JEPA inserts a reusable object-structured interface between a general visual encoder and task-specific predictors. We therefore initialize the visual encoder with V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , and jointly pretrain the slot decomposition module and Transition Memory Predictor (TMP). The module converts patch representations into stable slots and spatial masks, which serve as the basic TMP inputs and outputs. After pretraining, we freeze the visual encoder and slot decomposition module, and fine-tune the transferred TMP on each downstream control task. A UOT-based loss is applied during training and planning.

blocks.en: The temporally stable slots make compact, query-dependent reuse of the observed trajectory possible: visual states can be stored as masks and compared through statistics of corresponding slots. During training, the observed transitions in each sampled video clip provide the context directly. At inference, TMP samples relevant and diverse context transitions 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} based on the query state and mask geometry. It then uses the same symmetric context–query structure to predict the next mask in both settings.

The evaluation settings are detailed in Appendix B.2 .

blocks.en:
We evaluate three in-distribution (ID) tasks and their out-of-distribution (OOD) variants. The ID tasks use the same layouts and object shapes during training and testing, whereas the OOD variants use previously unseen layouts or object shapes. In TwoRoom (also called Wall in prior work) and Maze ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , a point agent passes through a doorway and a ball navigates a U-shaped corridor, respectively. Both use position and velocity as r t r_{t} , while a t a_{t} specifies velocity in TwoRoom and force in Maze. In PushT ( Florence et al., 2022 ; Chi et al., 2025 ) , a pusher moves a T-shaped object and itself to their target poses; r t r_{t} is the pusher state and a t a_{t} is a relative target tracked by a PD controller. The OOD variants TwoRoomR and MazeR randomize obstacle layouts, while PushObj changes the object shape. Each task provides an initial image v 0 v_{0} and visual goal v g v_{g} . For comparison, we report DINO-WM baselines that additionally use the low-dimensional goal state for planning in TwoRoom and PushT. We evaluate 50 cases per environment using MPC ( Rawlings et al., 2026 ) with CEM ( de Boer et al., 2005 ) .

blocks.en: Based on the REALM manipulation environment and task configurations ( Sedlacek et al., 2026 ) , we construct the REALM-JEPA dataset for JEPA-based visual-goal planning. It provides start observations and stage-wise visual goals for 108 cases in four task families: 18 Reach cases and 30 each for Pick , Rotate , and Place . We fine-tune the robot dynamics predictor on DROID trajectories ( Khazatsky and others, 2024 ) . The training settings are detailed in Appendix B.4 .
blocks.zh: 根据REALM操纵环境和任务配置(Sedlacek等,2026年),我们为基于JEPA的可视目标规划构建REALM-JEPA数据集. 它为四个任务家庭的108个案例提供了初步观察和分阶段视觉目标: 18 到达案例 和30个 选择,旋转,和位置。 我们微调DROID轨迹上的机器人动力学预测器(Khazatsky等,2024年). 培训环境详见附录B.4。

blocks.en: In each task, we control a 7-DoF robot arm: six dimensions describe the end-effector (EE) pose, and one specifies the gripper opening angle. At step t t , the visual observation v t v_{t} contains images from two fixed external cameras and one wrist camera. Following V-JEPA 2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) , we provide up to two stage-wise visual goals, each comprising images from the same three views, as illustrated in Fig. 3 . The low-dimensional state r t r_{t} contains the current EE pose, gripper angle, and camera poses. The action a t a_{t} specifies changes to the EE pose and gripper angle. The three views share one predictor, but maintain separate slots, transition memories, and predictions. At each MPC step, the two fixed views first update the CEM distribution; the wrist view then starts from that distribution, continues the search, and selects the action for execution. An inverse-kinematics controller converts the selected absolute EE pose into joint targets, which the arm tracks using PD feedback. Each planning attempt is limited to 100 MPC steps. Since ℓ 1 \ell_{1} losses provide weak guidance at large displacements, we use ground-truth target-position guidance for the patch-based baselines until the EE is within 30 cm of the target position. Slot-JEPA uses visual goal only throughout. Full multi-view and guidance details are provided in Appendix B.4 .

Tab. 3 reports success rates for the four task families. To assess whether the visual goal loss reflects physical progress, Tab. 4 reports its Spearman correlation with 7-DoF EE–goal distance, using both losses predicted by the predictor and losses computed from the observations after execution. We also examine how the observed goal loss changes over planning steps in Fig. 4 . Appendix B.4 gives the complete correlation definitions and statistics.
These results support three conclusions: 1) Slot-JEPA improves success across all four task families, especially Rotate and Place. Its overall success rate is 86.1%, compared with 35.2% for V-JEPA 2.1 and 58.3% for V-JEPA 2.1 + TMP. On Rotate and Place, Slot-JEPA reaches 83.3% and 76.7%, respectively, compared with 20.0% and 0.0% for V-JEPA 2.1. 2) Pointwise ℓ 1 \ell_{1} losses give weak guidance far from the goal. Despite this ground-truth guidance, both patch-based baselines still fail often. Their losses computed from actual observations also correlate less strongly with EE–goal distance than Slot-JEPA’s loss, indicating that predictor error alone cannot explain these failures. 3) Replacing V-JEPA 2.1’s predictor with TMP substantially improves planning. The success rate rises from 35.2% to 58.3% while retaining the patch representation and goal loss. This gain is consistent with TMP retrieving useful information from the full trajectory history, whereas the original predictor relies on temporally contiguous frames and is restricted to nearby observations.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: Slot decomposition is trained without instance or part annotations, using feature reconstruction rather than physical identity as its objective. Its masks support planning, but one slot may merge multiple objects or split one object, so consistent instance- or part-level decomposition is not guaranteed. This can limit reasoning about specific components and contact points. TMP builds memory from observed transitions and retrieves context using fixed state and mask cues. These cues may miss contact or appearance changes and select redundant examples. Better memory construction and retrieval criteria that balance relevance with diversity remain open problems.
blocks.zh: 分解槽的培训没有实例或部分说明,而是以特征重建而不是以实际身份作为目标。 它的口罩支持规划,但一个插槽可能会将多个对象合并或将一个对象分割出,因此无法保证一致的实例-或部分级分解. 这可以限制特定组件和联络点的推理. TMP通过被观测到的过渡来构建内存并使用固定状态和口罩提示来取回上下文. 这些提示可能会错过联系人或外观变化,并选择多余的例子. 更好的内存构造和检索标准在相关性与多样性之间保持平衡,仍然是尚未解决的问题。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Slot-JEPA, which factorizes dense visual representations into stable object-structured slots and time-varying spatial masks for action-conditioned prediction. This structure enables a UOT planning loss that is better aligned with spatial progress when pointwise losses provide weak guidance. TMP further draws on relevant transitions beyond a short contiguous history. Across seven visual-understanding benchmarks, mixtures of encoder and slot-reconstructed features remain transferable, while six planar environments and four Robotic Arm Planning tasks in the REALM-JEPA dataset show improved planning success, especially on the more complex manipulation tasks. These results show the value of combining structured mask prediction, spatially informed goal costs, and transition memory for visual planning.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Slot-JEPA,它将稠密的视觉表现转化为稳定的物体结构槽和时间变化的空间口罩,用于行动条件的预测. 这种结构使得UOT规划损失能够更好地与空间进步相配合,而当指向损失提供薄弱的指导时。 TMP进一步借鉴了超越短暂相接历史的相关过渡. 在7个可视理解的基准中,编码器和插槽重构功能的混合物仍然可以转移,而REALM-JEPA数据集中的6个平面环境和4个机器人臂规划任务显示规划成功程度有所提高,特别是在更加复杂的操纵任务方面。 这些结果显示了将结构化的口罩预测,空间上知情的目标成本,以及可视化规划的过渡内存等结合起来的价值.

blocks.en: A.1 Complete Slot Decomposition
blocks.zh: A.1 完全分解槽

blocks.en: During pretraining, the reference set 𝒱 S \mathcal{V}^{S} consists only of the observed/context frames in the sampled clip; none of the target frames to be predicted are used to construct the slots. We encode these frames once and partition their patch features into non-overlapping windows spanning 4 × 4 4\times 4 spatial patches. Within each window, four input patch tokens at evenly spaced valid positions initialize four local slots. This feature-dependent initialization avoids introducing a separate learned slot template while retaining spatial diversity.
blocks.zh: 在预训期间,参考集V S\ mathcal{V}^{S}仅由被样本片段中的被观测到/被文本框组成;任何被预测的目标框都不用于构建槽. 我们把这些相框编码一次,然后把它们的补丁特性分割成非重叠窗口,跨越4×4 4\4次的空间补丁. 每个窗口内,4个输入补丁符号均匀间距的有效位置初始化了4个本地位. 这种依赖特性的初始化在保留空间多样性的同时避免引入单独的已学习到的槽模板.

blocks.en: Each local window is processed by three Slot Attention iterations. In every iteration, layer-normalized slots form queries and layer-normalized patch tokens form keys and values. Attention is normalized first across the competing slots and then across the input tokens assigned to each slot. The resulting weighted value is passed through a GRU update followed by a residual two-layer MLP, as formalized in Sec. 3.2 . We pool the local slots from all windows and select K = 16 K=16 of them by farthest-point sampling (FPS) in feature space. FPS starts from a valid local slot and repeatedly chooses the slot with the largest distance to its nearest selected slot. The selected features initialize a second, global Slot Attention module, which applies the same three-step iterative update to the pooled local-slot candidates and produces the shared slot bank 𝑺 \bm{S} . The complete local-to-global extraction and mask-decoding network is shown in Fig. 7 .

FPS从一个有效的本地位开始,再三选择最远到最近所选位的位. 所选的特性初始化了第二个全局分槽注意模块,该模块对集合本地分槽候选人应用了相同的三步迭接更新,并产生了共享分槽库S\bm{S}. 图7显示完整的局部到全球取出和口罩解码网络。

blocks.en: The mask decoder first projects patch features and slots to width 128. Two decoder blocks alternately update the patch queries by cross-attending to the fixed slot bank and by applying self-attention among patches. For every patch–slot pair, an MLP receives the concatenated decoded patch feature and slot feature and produces an assignment logit. A softmax across the K K slots yields 𝑴 \bm{M} , and the mask-weighted slot sum reconstructs the original dense representation as in Eq. ( 1 ). We jointly optimize the local and global Slot Attention modules and the mask decoder with the feature-reconstruction and slot-orthogonality terms in Sec. 3.2 . The same extracted slot bank is held fixed when decoding the observed, predicted, and goal frames of one environment. blocks.en: Fig. 8 shows the layer-level architecture of the two TMP branches. TMP uses branch-specific context–query stacks. The reconstructed-feature branch has 12 blocks of width 192 with three attention heads. The mask branch applies separate object-wise predictors at three spatial scales, each with four blocks. Their ( spatial size , width , heads ) (\text{spatial size},\text{width},\text{heads}) configurations are ( 16 , 48 , 3 ) (16,48,3) , ( 12 , 96 , 3 ) (12,96,3) , and ( 6,196 , 4 ) (6,196,4) . The current and future fields are concatenated channel-wise at each scale; the unavailable future query field is replaced by learned tokens. After attention, we retain only the query positions associated with those future tokens, upsample the three outputs, and concatenate them to form 𝑯 t + 1 mask \bm{H}^{\mathrm{mask}}_{t+1} . The shared feature branch uses the same context–query organization on the reconstructed feature field and masks to model interactions across slots. Its output is fused with every object-wise mask feature before the slot-wise softmax. These dimensions are fixed in comparisons with the sequential-predictor ablation unless stated otherwise.

blocks.en: Each pretraining sample contains seven frames: four observed/context frames and three held-out target frames. We construct both directions from every clip. In the forward case, the first four frames predict the last three; in the backward case, the last four predict the first three. Thus the predictor learns a relation between observed transitions and a query transition without relying on a fixed chronological direction. The observed transitions from the same sampled clip directly form the training context, so pretraining neither retrieves from nor maintains a persistent memory bank.

blocks.en: Natural pretraining videos have no action labels. We therefore reconstruct each pair of source and target frames from their masks and shared slots, and feed the paired reconstructions and masks to an inverse transition encoder. A spatial projection, learned condition tokens, and an eight-layer, three-head Transformer of width 192 compress their change into the low-dimensional pseudo-action a ~ t \tilde{a}_{t} in Sec. 3.3 . A companion Transformer with the same dimensions maps each reconstructed frame and its masks to a pseudo-state. The target reaches TMP through these low-dimensional condition tokens rather than through the full target mask field. After pretraining, both inverse encoders are discarded and replaced by task-specific state and action encoders; the TMP body is transferred.

blocks.en: All entries in an inference memory bank are observed transitions decoded with one common slot bank. blocks.en: We initialize the visual encoder from the released distilled V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-B/16 checkpoint ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . This 80M-parameter encoder is distilled from the 2B-parameter V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-G teacher on VisionMix-163M, which combines LVD-142M images with videos from SSv2, Kinetics, HowTo100M, and YT-1B. We then pretrain Slot-JEPA on the training split of Kinetics-400 ( Kay et al., 2017 ) , which contains roughly 240,000 clips. The complete dataset contains 306,245 clips from 400 human-action classes. Each clip lasts approximately 10 seconds and comes from a distinct YouTube video. Its content spans individual actions such as drawing and drinking, person–person interactions such as hugging and shaking hands, and person–object interactions such as opening objects and playing instruments. We decode the videos at 384 × 384 384\times 384 resolution.

blocks.en: We construct REALM-JEPA from the REALM simulator and task configurations ( Sedlacek et al., 2026 ) to evaluate visual-goal planning in tabletop manipulation. The environment uses a mounted Franka Panda arm with a Robotiq gripper. At every step, it synchronously renders × 720 1280\!\times\!720 RGB observations from two fixed external cameras and one wrist-mounted camera. The robot state comprises a 6-D end-effector (EE) pose and the gripper opening, and the 7-D action specifies an absolute EE target pose and gripper command. REALM-JEPA contains 108 cases across four task families. Reach includes 18 targets corresponding to the six Pick objects, six Rotate objects, and six objects used in Place. Each of the other families contains six task definitions under five scene configurations—the nominal scene, two shifted target-object poses, a block-distractor scene, and a shifted-distractor scene—giving 30 Pick, 30 Rotate, and 30 Place cases. Pick uses a banana, bowl, soda can, lemon, marker, or spoon; Rotate uses a banana, soda can, marker, mug, toy die, or water bottle; and Place uses the six object–receptacle pairs banana–box, soda can–bowl, green block–bowl, lemon–tray, marker–bowl, and orange–bowl. In total, the benchmark covers 11 manipulated-object types and three receptacle types, with 18 + 3 × ( 6 × 5 ) = 108 18+3\times(6\times 5)=108 cases.
blocks.zh: 我们从REALM模拟器和任务配置(Sedlacek等,2026年)中构建REALM-JEPA,以评价桌面操纵中的可视目标规划. 环境使用架起的Franka Panda手臂并配有Robotiq抓取器. 每一步,它都会同步地从两台固定的外相机和一台手腕挂相机中使出x720 1280\!\times\!720 RGB观测结果. 机器人状态由6-D端效(EE)姿势和抓取器开口组成,7-D动作指定了绝对的EE目标姿势和抓取器指令. REALM-JEPA涉及四个任务家庭的108个案例。 达到目标包括18个对应6个Pick对象的目标,6个旋转对象,以及Place中使用的6个对象. 其他每个家庭在5个场景配置下包含6个任务定义——名义场景、2个变相目标物体外观、1个被挡住的场景和1个变相的被挡住的场景——30 Pick、30 Rotion和30 Place案例。 选取使用香蕉、碗、苏打罐、柠檬、标记或勺子; 旋转使用香蕉、苏打罐、标记、杯子、玩具死亡或水瓶; Place使用六个对象 — — 接受对香蕉-盒、苏打罐-碗、绿色块-碗、柠檬-缸、标记-碗和橙-碗。 基准总共涵盖11个被操纵物体类型和3个贮器类型,18 + 3 × (6 × 5) = 108 18+3\tims (6\times 5) = 108个案件。

blocks.en:
Each benchmark case fixes the task configuration and initial simulator state, and provides synchronized visual goals from all three cameras. These goals are sampled from a scripted successful reference trajectory; the reference actions and intermediate states are used only to construct the benchmark and are unavailable to the planner. Fig. 11 shows representative start and goal observations for every task family.
Reach moves the EE to the target object and uses one visual goal. Pick reaches and grasps the object before lifting it, Rotate grasps and changes its orientation, and Place grasps, transports, and releases it into the designated receptacle; these longer tasks use two successive visual goals. Every goal contains the same three synchronized views as the current observation.
blocks.zh:
每个基准案例都会确定任务配置和初始模拟状态,并提供所有三个相机的同步可视目标. 这些目标取自一个脚本的成功参考轨迹;参考行动和中间状态仅用于构建基准,规划者无法使用. 图11显示了每个任务家庭的代表性开端和目标观察。
Reach将EE移动到目标对象上并使用一个可视目标. 选择在升起前到达并抓住物体,旋转抓住并改变其取向,并位置抓住、运输并放入指定的贮器;这些较长的任务使用两个相接的可视目标。 每个目标包含与当前观测相同的三个同步视图.

blocks.en: We compare with the standard V-JEPA 2.1 predictor ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) and V-JEPA 2.1 + TMP, which keeps patch representations and the original goal loss but uses our transition-memory architecture. This isolates the effect of the predictor design from the slot-based state interface. On place and rotate tasks, both patch-based baselines use the ground-truth target EE position to bias CEM proposals while the 3-D positional distance exceeds 30 cm. Specifically, the proposal mean is initialized with 20% of the target displacement and clipped per axis to 20% of the action cap. At 30 cm or closer, the bias is disabled and planning uses the visual goal loss alone. Slot-JEPA does not use this guidance.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了标准的V-JEPA 2.1预测器(Mur-Labadia等,2026年)和V-JEPA 2.1 + TMP,它保留了补丁表达和原目标损失,但使用了我们的过渡-记忆架构. 这将预测器设计的效果从基于槽的状态界面中隔离出. 在位置和旋转任务上,两个以补丁为基础的基线都使用地真目标EE位置来偏向CEM建议,而3-D位置距离则会超过30厘米. 具体地说,该提议的意思是初始化的,目标迁移的20%,并被每轴剪到行动上限的20%。 在30公分或更近处,偏差被禁用,规划仅使用视觉目标损失. Slot-JEPA没有使用这一指导。

blocks.en: Each REALM-JEPA case begins with a short random-action warmup. The initial frame, provided goal images, and warmup observations form the reference set for each view’s slot extraction; the observed warmup transitions initialize its corresponding memory bank. Goal images contribute reference features but no memory transitions. Goal-directed planning starts only after this initialization, and each newly observed transition is appended to the appropriate per-view bank. After an extended rollout, slots may be refreshed from accumulated observed frames. All retained transitions are then decoded again so that their memory masks remain aligned with the refreshed slots. No future frame from the evaluated rollout is used for initialization or refresh.
blocks.zh: 每一个REALM-JEPA案例都从短暂的随机动作热身开始. 初始框架提供了目标图像,热能观测构成了每个视图取出槽的参考集;所观测到的热能转换初始化了相应的内存库. 目标图像提供了参考功能,但没有内存过渡。 目标导向规划仅在初始化之后才开始,每个新观察到的过渡都附在适当的每个视图库中。 在扩展推出后,可以从累积观测到的帧中刷新槽. 所有被保留的过渡再被解码,使其内存口罩能与刷新槽保持对接. 经评价推出的未来框架不用于初始化或刷新。

blocks.en: The robot predictor is trained on seven-frame DROID ( Khazatsky and others, 2024 ) clips sampled at 1 fps and resized to 384 × 384 384\times 384 . Training uses eight GPUs, four clips per GPU, bfloat16 precision, seed 239, 100 epochs, and 300 iterations per epoch. The visual encoder and slot decomposition module remain frozen, while TMP and the task-specific state and action encoders are optimized with AdamW using ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) , ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , and weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} ; bias and normalization parameters are excluded from weight decay. The learning rate increases linearly from 10 − 4 10^{-4} to 10 − 3 10^{-3} over the first 15 epochs, remains at 10 − 3 10^{-3} for 70 epochs, and decays linearly to zero over the final 15 epochs. We set ( λ uot , λ mask , λ feat ) = ( 3.0 , 3.0 , 0.1 ) (\lambda_{\mathrm{uot}},\lambda_{\mathrm{mask}},\lambda_{\mathrm{feat}})=(3.0,3.0,0.1) in ℒ pred \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{pred}} , with five Sinkhorn iterations and ε = 0.05 \varepsilon=0.05 . Each training sample uses four observed frames to predict three future target frames and additionally applies two autoregressive prediction steps.

blocks.en: The 7-D planning command consists of a 6-D end-effector target pose and a scalar gripper-opening command. In absolute-pose mode, the arm controller computes Cartesian pose error, maps it through inverse kinematics to desired joint positions, and applies joint-space PD feedback with Jacobian-weighted Cartesian gains. A separate continuous gripper controller applies the opening command. We allow at most 100 MPC steps per planning attempt.
blocks.zh: 7-D规划指令由6-D终端效果目标姿势和scalar抓取开口指令组成. 在绝对pose模式下,臂控制器会计算笛卡尔出错,通过逆向动能将它映射到所期望的联合位置,并应用由雅各比克加权的笛卡尔增益的相接空间PD反馈. 单独的连续抓取控制器应用开口命令. 我们允许最多100个MPC步骤 每次规划尝试。

blocks.en: B.5 Additional Visualizations
blocks.zh: B.5 其他可视化

blocks.en: Fig. 12 shows how the goal loss varies over sampled states. Low-loss regions follow feasible progress toward the goal while the obstacle-aware ground cost assigns less favorable energy to visually nearby but obstructed states, yielding a planning signal that better reflects scene geometry.
blocks.zh: 图12显示了目标损失在抽样状态中的差异。 低损失地区在实现目标方面取得可行的进展,而意识到障碍的地面成本却给视线附近但受阻的状态分配了不太有利的能量,从而产生了更好地反映场景几何特征的规划信号。

blocks.en: Figure 12: Additional goal-loss landscapes in MazeR and TwoRoomR. Each sampled state is rendered independently; the panels visualize energy geometry rather than executed rollouts. Stars mark goals, and lighter colors indicate lower loss.
blocks.zh: 图12:MazeR和TwoRoomR的更多入球-损失地貌。 每个抽样状态都是独立的;面板可视化能几何,而不是执行推出. 恒星标记入球,而更浅的颜色表示损失更低.

blocks.en: Figure 13: Predicted slot masks along successful TwoRoomR, MazeR, PushObj, and Place planning rollouts (top left, top right, bottom left, and bottom right, respectively). Each column pairs the RGB observation obtained after action execution with masks predicted for the same time step. The planar panels show mask heatmaps, whereas the Place panel overlays sharpened predictions on the executed wrist-view RGB.
blocks.zh: 图13:成功的 " 二室 " 、 " 马泽 " 、 " PushObj " 和 " Place " 规划的推出(分别是左上、右上、左下和右下)。 每列将动作执行后获得的RGB观测对齐,并预想同一时间步骤的口罩. 平面板显示口罩热图,而"Place"面板则在已执行的手腕-视图RGB上覆盖了更清晰的预测.

blocks.en: Fig. 13 compares action-conditioned slot-mask predictions with the RGB observations obtained after execution. The predicted masks track the task-relevant regions across environments and time. Because the future is represented as separate slot masks, the prediction is also more interpretable: one can inspect which object or region is expected to move and where, rather than only comparing an opaque dense latent.
blocks.zh: 图13 将行动条件槽-掩码预测与执行后获得的RGB观测数据进行比较. 预测的口罩在环境和时间上跟踪与任务有关的区域。 由于未来是以单独的槽口罩表示的,预测也比较容易被解释:人们可以检查哪个物体或区域要移动,在哪里,而不是仅仅比较一个不透明的密集潜伏.

blocks.en: Figures 14 – 17 visualize individual slots as colored masks over the input RGB frames. Across Kinetics-400 pretraining videos and DROID downstream-training clips, different slots emphasize distinct objects or spatial regions and remain recognizable over time. This decomposition exposes which parts of a scene contribute to the latent state instead of collapsing them into one dense feature map.
blocks.zh: 图14 – 17在输入RGB帧上将单个插槽可视化为有色口罩. 在Kinetics-400的预训视频和DROID下游的训练剪辑中,不同的插槽强调不同的物体或空间区域,并随着时间的推移仍然可以识别。 这种分解揭示了某一场景的哪些部分有助于潜在状态,而不是将其分解成一个密集的地物图.

blocks.en: Overall, these visualizations indicate that slot decomposition provides a spatially structured and inspectable state, while UOT and TMP turn that state into goal-directed costs and coherent future-mask predictions.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些可视化表明,槽分解提供了空间结构化和可检查状态,而UOT和TMP则将这种状态转变为目标导向成本和连贯的未来任务预测.
